Name: (CP x AT) Sodacchi's Starry Trees
Author: Sodacchi
Description:
[size=5][b]1.6+[/b][/size]

Content Patcher now allows to add new items directly without Json Assets.

[size=4][u][b]SEASONAL version[/b][/u][/size]
[spoiler][b]WHERE TO BUY THE TREE:[/b]
﻿You need to buy it from Robin.

[b]DETAILS:[/b]
﻿There's one tree to buy which changes every season.
﻿  - To change variations, use [[b][color=#cc4125]AT[/color][/b]] 's paint bucket.

[b]﻿﻿INSTALL:[/b]
﻿﻿  [color=#f4f4f4]- [/color][color=#e69138]Install SMAPI, Content Patcher, Alternative Textures and MMAP.[/color]
﻿﻿  ﻿﻿﻿- ﻿[size=2][i](Delete old versions if you are updating them.)[/i][/size]
﻿﻿  - Download the mod and extract it to your \[i]Mods[/i] folder.
﻿﻿  ﻿- Run the game using SMAPI.[/spoiler]

[size=4][u][b]NON-SEASONAL version[/b][/u][/size]
[spoiler][b]WHERE TO BUY THE TREES:[/b]
﻿You need to buy them from Robin.

[b]DETAILS:[/b]
﻿There are all 4 default trees, they don't change when season changes.
﻿  - To change variations, use [[b][color=#cc4125]AT[/color][/b]] 's paint bucket.

[b]﻿﻿INSTALL:[/b]
﻿﻿  [color=#f4f4f4]- [/color][color=#e69138]Install SMAPI, Content Patcher, Alternative Textures and MMAP.[/color]
﻿﻿  ﻿﻿﻿- ﻿[size=2][i](Delete old versions if you are updating them.)[/i][/size]
﻿﻿  - Download the mod and extract it to your \[i]Mods[/i] folder.
﻿﻿  ﻿- Run the game using SMAPI.[/spoiler]
[size=3][b]AVAILABLE RECOLORS:[/b][/size]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10635]Blue Grass Recolor[/url] [i][color=#999999][size=2](Default)[/size][/color][/i]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolor
[/url]
